title: 2013-14 Accord: power steering assist lost, EPS DTC 53-01 / 53-02, 13-year warranty extension
summary: Honda product update and warranty extension: the EPS torque sensor can fail and the control unit shuts off assist. A software update keeps partial assist on a sensor failure, and steering gearboxes with DTC 53-01 or 53-02 are covered for 13 years from original purchase, no mileage limit.

specs.name: Vehicles
specs.value: 2013-14 Accord, 2014 Accord Plug-in Hybrid, 2014 Accord Hybrid

specs.name: Warranty extension
specs.value: 13 years from original date of purchase, no mileage limit

specs.name: Not covered
specs.value: Vehicles ever declared a total loss, sold for salvage, or with a branded title

steps.text: Complaint: loss of power steering assist.
Do the EPS software update. It changes the control unit so a torque sensor failure leaves partial assist instead of none.
During the update, check for DTC 53-01 or 53-02. If either is set, the steering gearbox is replaced under the extension.
Owners who already paid for a gearbox for these codes may be eligible for reimbursement, even if they no longer own the car.

body: Honda told owners to allow about half a day for the update visit.
